fields.value: Retinal PSF Simulator for General Light Field Display

dsDescriptionValue.value: This Simulator computes retinal point spread functions (PSFs) that are rendered by a light field display with varying depths of a rendered point and accommodation distances. For theoretical background, analytical expressions and (most importantly) assumptions and limitations, refer to our paper (Yuta Miyanishi, Erdem Sahin, and Atanas Gotchev. 2022. “Optical Modelling of Accommodative Light Field Display System and Prediction of Human Eye Responses.” Optics Express 30 (21). https://doi.org/10.1364/oe.458651.)

publicationCitation.value: Optical modelling of an accommodative light field display system and prediction of human eye responses
